lines: On Halloween night, downtown Maesaki City had been engulfed by a sudden mania.
「Uwaaaaah?! Wh-What's with these guys? Don't come near meeee!!!」
Rioters were attacking people, who fled in a panic.
「Dammit, stop!! What the hell are these guys?!」
「Sergeant! They're toppling over a kei truck over there――Ahh?! They're coming this way too!!」
Even the police opposition was swept away by the sheer force and number of them.
Young people, each dressed up in the Halloween costume of their choice, turning into rioters and going on rampages――
Gleefully looking down at that scene from midair was an odd, pumpkin-headed monster.
『Riot, humans, riot!! You should vent your everyday frustrations like that to your hearts' content～♪』
It had the ability to remove the inhibitions from frustrated people, and turn them into rioters who simply followed their destructive impulses.
That troublesome monster had appeared in the nighttime entertainment district, which was in a festive mood for Halloween.
『Humans bottle up too much stress, don't you? You should just forget the tough stuff and be happy! Here♪』
「S-Stop! I don't want to be hap――」
The monster's eyes gleamed, and a strange beam of light was emitted.
A woman who looked to be a gang member, who was running around in a panic to try and escape, was engulfed by that, and collapsed with a thud. But, straight after that――
The gang member-like woman stood up, joined the rioters, and began to go on a rampage.
The rioters' complexions were as pale as zombies', yet their shouts, at least, were oddly cheerful.
The mayhem in the streets only intensified due to their acts of barbarism――But, at that time.
「That's far enough, phantom!!!! You're the cause of this uproar, aren't you?!」
A young woman stood in the way in front of the monster, vigilantly readying a sword.
「I am Taimanin Shinganji Kurenai. Evil fiend who leads human hearts astray――I am duty-bound to exterminate you!」
The woman declared her name sharply, with a look of fearless determination.
Taimanin was the term for ninja who had organized to destroy “evil beings” that did people harm.
And so, too, on this night, receiving word of a “monster appearance”, Taimanin Shinganji Kurenai had hurried to the scene.
『Taimanin......? You're dressed pretty festive for that, though.』
It was certainly as the Spirit of Halloween pointed out.
What she was wearing was a witch's costume, which seemed to have a Halloween motif.
It was completely different from her regular Taimanin suit, which had combat functionality.
Overall, it was a casual outfit, with a cute, frilly design, which didn't seem at all like the sort of thing one would go to battle in.
「Th-This is...... Never mind! It doesn't really matter what I'm wearing for battle!」
『No, I'm curious. To all appearances, that's a festive party costume――』
『Right? You guys are curious about it too, aren't you?』
Having had that brought up, the rioters pointed at Kurenai and cheered, 「Yay, yay!」
Indeed――It wasn't as though she had come to battle in a festive outfit like this because she wanted to.
There were circumstances beyond her control, that she herself couldn't help......
「S-Say, Ayame, this isn't weird, is it......?」
How many times had they had this exchange already?

Kurenai seemed to be concerned about how the costume she was going to wear for Halloween would turn out, and had put it on to check multiple times since the previous night, even though there was no need to do so.
「R-Really?! That's good! I mean, it's not like I care what I wear, so I don't mind, but――」
「But, I can't afford to embarrass the guy who invited me, right?! So I'm glad it's not weird!」
「Yes, I'm sure Kotarou-sama will like it as well.」
Seeing the uncharacteristically giddy state of her master, Ayame made a face that said, 「Dear me.」
The reason that Kurenai was acting like this was that she had reunited with Kotarou, the present head of the Fuuma clan.
Getting caught up in an incident about a cyborg Taimanin who had run away from the UFS, she had met Kotarou face-to-face for the first time in a long while.
Actually, it was their first reunion in years.
At the time, they had been busy with various things and hadn't had much time to talk, but
They had parted ways exchanging contact information with one another, saying 「Let's meet up again once things have settled down.」
That said, they were both very busy with missions and training.
Their schedules just wouldn't align, until finally their days off overlapped on Halloween.
「That's perfect. It looks like there's going to be a Halloween festival in Maesaki City, so why don't you go with us too?」
Invited by him, they had arranged for Kurenai to also participate in the Halloween costume parade.
（Even when we talked, he was speaking so clearly and intelligently...... Haah...）
Her heart beat faster when she thought back on that.
――Kurenai, daughter of the former Fuuma Eight General of the Shinganji family, and Kotarou, the heir to the Fuuma head family, had known each other from a young age.
In her youth, she had tended to be a gloomy and withdrawn child, owing to the special circumstances of her birth.
She was isolated from those around her, and had no one to talk to closely apart from her grandfather and teacher, Shinganji Gen'an.
What then appeared was Fuuma Kotarou.
He had approached Kurenai cheerfully, without caring about the circumstances of her birth, and had even brought her into his circle of friends, such as Hebiko, Gaiza and Juubei.
He had taught her to enjoy everyday life like the other children.
Fortunately, this was a time when years had passed since Fuuma Danjou's rebellion, and the tension in the village had eased.
The presence of him and his friends, who never lost their cheerfulness even in adversity, had become an emotional crutch for Kurenai before she knew it.
She had come to leave Gosha with her grandfather, who had retired after taking blame for being complicit in the rebellion. But,
Even after having drifted apart like that, her feelings of gratitude and faint admiration towards Kotarou had never died.
（This Halloween, I have to behave perfectly, no matter what......!）
「I'm going to start practicing that line now, so could you check if I'm doing it right?」
Ayame stared at her in bafflement.
Earnestness and integrity were strong points of Kurenai's.
But on the other hand, she sometimes took that too far, and ventured into eccentric behaviour that wasn't easy to comprehend.
「It's because he said his friends are also coming this Halloween.」
「If my trick-or-treating is sub-par, it'll bring shame on him for inviting m――」
Kurenai tilted her head in confusion.
「How do I put this......? There's no real etiquette about Halloween these days. It's a casual event.」
「I think you should never mind the details, and just enjoy it in the normal manner.」
She cocked her head, with a face that said she still didn't quite get it.
「Besides which, it's Hebiko-chan who's coming with you, right? I doubt there's any need to fuss about it.」
「W-Well, that's true, but...... He said there will be other people I don't know coming too......」
Aishuu Hebiko was also one of the friends she had played with as a child.
Kurenai was looking forward to not only getting to meet Kotarou on this occasion, but Hebiko as well, after so long.
「At any rate, since you're looking forward to it that much, please make sure not to be late for your rendezvous, all right?」
「Unfortunately, I have a mission starting in the morning, so I won't be able to tell you that......」
「Yeah, I get it! Even I can at least keep the time, you know!」
She made a big nod towards Ayame, who had a concerned-looking face.
（So, this is no time to be doing something like this, and yet......!!）
Despite facing off against the Spirit of Halloween, on the inside, Kurenai was on the verge of tears.
About thirty minutes left before it was time for her meetup with Kotarou.
Truthfully, she ought to have been on her way to the meeting place already, but――
（Uuuh, that damn masked woman! Why do you have to come and commission us at a time like this......?!）
It was about fifteen minutes before Kurenai left the base.
Just as she had excitedly changed into her Halloween costume, and was about to head to the meeting place, a call had come in.
The caller was the masked woman affiliated with the UFS, who was a “regular” of theirs.
According to her, a troublesome monster was rampaging through Maesaki City.
She couldn't act because she had another mission, so she wanted Kurenai to hurry to the scene at once to subdue it.
In all honesty, Kurenai's mind was shaken.
If the monster suppression dragged on, she would be unable to enjoy Halloween with Kotarou and the others.
However, even that hesitation was only momentary.
For a Taimanin, it was natural to prioritize a mission over self-interest.
（But, as long as I just get the mission over with, there'll be nothing to complain about, will there?!）
With that grim determination in her mind, Kurenai charged in ferociously.
Her blade clashed with the lantern the monster held, making a sound like that of metal screeching.
『Keh keh...... So, even if you're dressed festively, you're a Taimanin on the inside, huh?』
Grinning daringly, it jumped backwards and away.
That was just as one would expect from an infamous monster.
It had probably sensed Kurenai's true strength to an extent, just from their first clash.
『......But I have no intention of going down easily either. I've got my own reasons too.』
『Yeah. Did you think I'm playing this prank just for fun? That would be a misapprehension.』
While gazing down at the streets, where the mayhem continued, the monster slowly began to explain.
『I am the Spirit of Halloween――a being born from the feelings of humans, especially poor individuals who are tired of living.』
“Life is hard. Work wears me out. There's a lot of overtime. Stress is building up. Sometimes I just want to forget about my obligations and go wild”――
Those kinds of negative thoughts from modern life piled up, and what was born from them was the Spirit of Halloween.
『Ukekeh...... You understand? Given time, those frustrations will sediment, and eat away at people. That's why I play my pranks.』
『I feel for those worn-out people, so I set their souls free, and make them happy for the whole night. That's my――』
Without listening to the monster's story at all, Kurenai went straight to attacking him with her sword.
『Oooiiiii?!! Wh-Why, you...... I was just telling a really good story, you know?!」
「......? No, sorry. I'm not interested in what you are. And more importantly, I don't have time for that right now.」
「But it's certain that you're causing trouble, so allow me to destroy you without delay.」
She chased after the fleeing monster, swinging her sword sharply.
『Hiiii?! What narrow-mindedness! It's thanks to people like you that the world isn't happy!』
It spun around, holding its lantern aloft, and bright-red flames flew toward her with a hot gust of air.
In a flash, a swirl of flame enveloped Kurenai's surroundings――
Without flinching in the slightest, she stepped into those flames.
A blade of air created by that instantly blew away the flames that covered her view.
「All right, with this, it'll be mission complete! Prepare yourself――!!!」
（Now I'll make it in time!! Please keep waiting, Fuuma!）
Kurenai closed the distance in a single breath.
Rather than negligence, it was more like impatience.
She had wanted to put an end to the mission as soon as possible.
And Ayame, her subordinate, who would have covered for that kind of overeagerness, wasn't with her on this night.
『Ukekekeh, got you, Taimanin!! Go, my happy ones!!』
When her field of vision opened up, a crowd of rioters were right there in front of her.
The instant it had blocked Kurenai's view with the flames of its lantern, the monster had summoned them around itself.
The rioters shuffled forward, their hands reaching out like zombies.
She was about to cut them down, but hesitated for a moment.
Though they may have been rioters, by nature they were just ordinary people who were being controlled.
Taking advantage of Kurenai's indecision, the monster's tentacles smoothly crept up on her from around the rioters' feet――
The monster's tentacles had twisted around them with surprising power, and taken away her freedom.
「Kuh, shit...... By such a...... joke of an enemy......?!」
She had been in such a hurry to make it for the meeting time that she had completely failed to notice the rioters' movements.
『Ukekeh! No matter what you call me, now that it's turned out like this, it's my win♪』
While laughing with plenty of composure, the pumpkin-headed monster approached.
『Well, now. Looks like you've built up quite a bit of frustration too, eh?』
『I'll make you forget everything, and become happy happy happy! Heeere♪』
Its eyes lit up brightly, and she was blasted with a brainwashing beam.
No matter if she focused the demonic power in her body to try and resist, even her consciousness soon grew fuzzy and faded away.
A carefree voice echoed inside her head, saying, 「Yay♪ Yay♪」
And she couldn't help but want to go on a rampage right now......
（Uuh...... Th-This is bad...... I can't be beaten by magic like this......）
（I have to take down this enemy...... and go to the Halloween festival with him......）
The rioters who were swarming around Kurenai had been blown away by a gigantic icicle that had appeared.
As a result of that, the restraints loosened slightly.
She dropped to the ground to escape from the monster's tentacles.
「h...... What the hell was that just now......?」
And then, when she groaningly lifted her face――
There was a young woman, wearing a sexy Halloween costume.
Her name was Onisaki Kirara. A student Taimanin from Gosha.
As a matter of fact, Kirara was also one of the people Kotarou had invited for Halloween.

Fifteen minutes before she left the house, just as she had excitedly changed into her Halloween costume, she had been given the order to subdue a monster, and, despite having almost lost her temper and yelled 「I'm
gonna be late, you know?!」, she had still come rushing to the scene.
「Th-Thanks...... Who are...... No, this is no occasion to be asking things like that, is it?」
「What a coincidence. I'm in a hurry too. I wanna put an end to this mission as soon as possible.」
The two of them exchanged sharp looks.
Though they each didn't know who the other was, it seemed like they were working to similar objectives.
Or rather, right now, the meeting time was more important than anything.
And the Hybrid Taimanin, who possessed both ninja arts and the power of the oni race.
Those two overwhelmingly strong people stepped forward towards the monster, who stiffened with fear.
